title: Mkpụrụ nke Esemokwu
intro: Tupu ụwa amata esemokwu zuru ebe niile, ule dị ukwuu nke okwukwe na nrubeisi pụtara. Akụkọ a na-enyocha nhọrọ nke onye mere, onye ihe o mere setịpụrụ ihe nlereanya maka ọgbọ ndị ga-abịa n'ihu. Kwadebe iji kọwaa akụkọ banyere mkpụrụ obi nke na-alụso oke ekworo na ihe ọjọọ ndị na-esi na ya apụta.
clues: Eso m n'ime ụmụ mbụ bi n'ụwa, bụ́ ụmụ nke di na nwunye mbụ ahụ.
E nyere mụ na nwanne m nwoke iwu ka anyị chụọrọ Allah àjà, nke bụ ule nke eziokwu anyị.
A nabataghị onyinye m, ebe a nabatakwara nke nwanne m nwoke, nke mere ka obi m jupụta n'oké mmetụta uche.
Ekwuru m okwu iyi egwu nye nwanne m nwoke, n'ihi obi ilu nke ịjụ.
Nwanne m nwoke zara ya n'amamihe na nsọpụrụ Chineke, na-echetara m ikpe ziri ezi nke Allah na egwu Ya.
N'agbanyeghị okwu dị nro nwanne m nwoke na ọchịchọ ya ịgbaghara, m gburu onwe m, wee bụrụ otu n'ime ndị furu efu.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
